propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeOpticalCableSegment
propertySets.definition: Properties of optical cables segments. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type OPTICALCABLESEGMENT.

properties.name: NumberOfFibers
properties.definition: Indicates the number of fibers in the single tube or cable.

properties.name: OpticalCableStructure
properties.definition: Distinguishes between different structures of an optical fiber cable.

properties.name: NumberOfMultiModeFibers
properties.definition: Total number of multi-mode fibers in the optical fiber cable.

properties.name: NumberOfSingleModeFibers
properties.definition: Total number of single-mode fibers in the optical fiber cable.

propertySets.name: Pset_OpticalPigtail
propertySets.definition: Property set for optical pigtail. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type OPTICALCABLESEGMENT.

properties.name: JacketColour
properties.definition: Indicates the colour of the cable or fitting jacket.

properties.name: FiberType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of the single fiber.

propertySets.name: Pset_PatchCordCable
propertySets.definition: This property set has properties that are applicable to cable segment and optical cable segment, indicated that the cable is a patch cord cable, which is fitted with connectors at both ends, allowing it to be rapidly and conveniently connected to other cables or to distribution panels.

properties.name: JacketColour
properties.definition: Indicates the colour of the cable or fitting jacket.
